title: An Analysis of Newcastle City Council's Debate on Inclusivity and Ethical Leadership
description: At the October 1st, 2024 Newcastle City Council meeting, debates over inclusivity, political agendas, and ethical leadership arose from discussions on "Hindu Heritage Month," the censure of a councilmember, and racial discrimination in the city’s Comprehensive Plan.
